title.narrative: Strengthen media development, diversity and supporting Community Media

description.narrative:
This workplan is dedicated to enhancing media strength, independence, and diversity through capacity-building, dialogue, and advocacy. We aim to promote media development, encourage media pluralism, and foster peaceful collaboration. A key focus is on empowering media professionals with skills to cover global challenges and emergencies.
In Bangladesh, supporting improved journalism and boosting journalists' abilities to address issues like disability equality, climate change, and gender equality is crucial. About 2.4% of Bangladesh’s population are persons with disabilities, who often face stigma and underrepresentation in media. The media can help create awareness and change narratives, promoting inclusivity. This work plan will advocate for gender equality in media content, promoting bias-free representations. We will develop a Bangla manual on disability equality in media and prioritize training women journalists. Community media, especially community radio, plays a vital role in rural outreach, education, and promoting social issues in Bangladesh. UNESCO will empower community media to locally produced programs to raise awareness on social issues, and combat mis/disinformation, hate speech.
